title: lithocardium calophyllum
intro: Lithocardium calophyllum, commonly known as Calophyllum inophyllum, is a species of evergreen tree native to the tropical regions of Australia, Asia, and the Pacific Islands. It is a valuable medicinal plant that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Lithocardium calophyllum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as cardiotonic, anti-hypertensive, and anti-cancer properties.
